title: Mexi Bean Quesadillas
subtitle: Budget-Busting Tummy Fillers!
description: Filling, tried-and-true flavours, and even more budget-friendly than our core menu – that’s our Thrifty Feed recipes! These classic dishes are perfect for when you want to put tasty, honest-to-goodness food on the table, and enjoy even more savings to boot.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Finely chop the capsicum. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Drain and rinse the beans.

Soften capsicum: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over high heat. Cook the capsicum, stirring, for 3 mins or until slightly softened. Add the garlic and Tex-Mex seasoning and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer filling: Add the beans, tomato passata and ¼ tsp sugar to the capsicum mixture and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring regularly, for 4 mins or until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Assemble quesadillas: Divide the bean mixture among the tortillas (see Make it yours). Scatter with the cheese, then fold the tortillas over to enclose the filling.

Bake quesadillas: Put the quesadillas on the lined tray and lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Bake for 6-8 mins until golden and the cheese is melted. Halve the quesadillas, divide among plates and enjoy!
Make it yours: If you have some on hand, scatter sliced spring onion over the bean mixture before scattering with the cheese. Add a drizzle of hot sauce too, if you like a kick of heat.
